physics_bounds.label: Zel'dovich density correction relative to LINEAR
Zel'dovich velocity correction relative to LINEAR

evidence.spread_how: The completed two-ulp SIGMA_8 selfcheck had bound_fraction 4.00e-6. Across one thread-layout probe and five additional seeds, low-k density/velocity powers moved by at most 19.7%/25.2%, mid-k by 4.2%/7.7%, high-k by 4.2%/4.3%, velocity summaries by 17.6%, initial--final relations by 2.6%, and the paired correction by 4.6%; all six realizations passed, with the closest at bound_fraction 0.963. Density--velocity relations remained far tighter. Collapsing Zel'dovich into LINEAR made both corrections zero and failed at 39.2 times the bound.

warrant: Broad bands and continuous summaries avoid identifying a random realization by phase. Mass conservation tests periodic CIC deposition. Low/mid-k initial--final coherence retains large-scale displacement physics; density--velocity and longitudinal tests retain the production Fourier relation. The paired LINEAR solve measures the nonzero first-order displacement/CIC correction directly: accidentally entering LINEAR makes it vanish, while entering 2LPT changes it and the retained invariants.
